citation: Gideon Weissman. bussim2 0.3.3. Python Package Index. Released 2023-05-03. https://pypi.org/project/bussim2/
description: bussim2 is a Python model that simulates electric bus operations at a depot to estimate the buses, chargers and power supply needed to deliver scheduled service. It dispatches vehicles to bus blocks, tracks battery state of charge, charging queues and depot power limits, and can account for solar generation and stationary storage. Its event-driven operations use SimPy. Inputs include bus-block schedules, a start date and run length, vehicle and charger characteristics, depot power limits and optional energy resources. Outputs include service completion tables, activity and battery plots, energy and power summaries, and a search for a minimum feasible number of buses, chargers and power capacity. The package description says its included service data and holiday calendar are based on New York MTA operations in 2022, while users can adapt inputs for other agencies. This makes it relevant to electric public transport and depot-capacity planning. PyPI lists version 0.3.3, released 2023-05-03, with Beta development status and an MIT licence. The project documentation and source links listed by PyPI returned service errors during this review, so the package was not installed or run, and the current state of its source repository was not verified. Its energy-consumption equations were fitted in separate work whose code is not included. The SimPy platform record is related; compatibility was not tested.
